title: Bookings per class
statementMd:
Average fare per seat class, rounded to 2 decimals.

Expected columns: `seat_class`, `avg_fare`.

Tables: `airlines`, `airports`, `flights`, `bookings`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT seat_class, ROUND(AVG(fare), 2) AS avg_fare FROM bookings GROUP BY seat_class;
```
